policy: Classify exact DCS types using shipped geometry, resolved chassis data and primary transport documentation, not family names or speed alone. Mode describes operational relocation: towed includes equipment packed as vehicle cargo and complete transportable vehicles whose deployed DCS definition has no native driver. Each such piece needs one included tractor. Physical platform distinctions are recorded separately. No type gains can_tow and no transit-defence whitelist changes. Fixed installations stay blocked. Retired identifiers migrate to current native types; no installed mods or campaign layouts are modified. Native mission driving/fire/recovery probes were not run.

units.reason: The exact DCS radar is Freya LZ, the transportable dismantlable version. An original British Air Ministry interrogation report documents dismantling, packing and airlifting a Freya LZ, then re-erecting it. Under the existing packed-vehicle-cargo abstraction, this is externally transported equipment rather than a permanently fixed radar or a self-propelled vehicle.

sources.summary: Version-pinned dump of actual DCS runtime tables, matching the installed DCS build. Explicitly establishes exact Freya LZ identity and shape. The source does not model self-propelled chassis or a transport animation.
Eagle Dynamics official WWII Assets Pack product inventory identifies the radar as FuMG 401 Freya LZ. Primary exact DCS identity source.

Original Air Ministry A.D.I.(K) Report 390/1945, PDF page 7 (zero-based), paragraph 40. Records a Freya LZ stand dismantled and packed into three Ju 52 aircraft within three days; operational at Stavanger eight days after the request. The report's introduction says it is based on interrogation of General Martini and staff, supported by contemporary documents. The title page warns that prisoner statements had not yet been independently verified. This is positive dismantlable-transport evidence, not proof of wheels or a road towbar.

limitations: Catalog and native-mission serialization tests are not a live DCS driving, weapons or recovery test.
Carrier-assisted relocation is the existing one-tractor-per-piece gameplay abstraction, not a literal towing animation or exact real-world lift-capacity model.
FuMG-401 and FuSe-65 WWII models are not installed locally; exact native variant declarations and primary historical/model imagery establish their classifications.
No installed mods or save files are edited. Catalog metadata and obsolete unit-class aliases refresh when an existing save is loaded.

native_inspection.scope: Focused static string/function inspection, including Car::setMaxSpeed at 0x180010b30. This did not resolve per-SAM carrier or propulsion data, and is not used to promote unknown types. No target code was executed.

runtime_baseline.source_kind: Primary runtime table export published by exporter author; not a fresh local runtime probe.

geometry_method.method: Parse exact local EDM v10 triangle meshes and scene transforms; inspect four untextured rest-pose views. Cumulative parent-range ends, duplicate identical parents and native per-vertex parent selectors are handled separately, with bounds and index validation. All render nodes are included; runtime visibility, textures, animations and driving are not simulated.
geometry_method.distribution: Only model names, hashes and observations are recorded here, not copyrighted model bytes or extracted meshes.

interpreter_inspection.scope: Static imports/strings and harmless interpreter checks identified standard Lua 5.1 loading, not DCS encrypted database/VFS loading. Packed Database.edce was not decoded; resolved per-unit data comes from the version-pinned runtime-table export, not this executable inspection.
